applies_why: The judge text makes lack of explicit textual resolution a reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the practice K-S2 governs.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: single verse does not state a link or its contrary — two readings: lack of explicit resolution in one verse may support UNDERDETERMINED, or K-S2 forbids using that lack as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
why: The judge marks Romans 1:3 UNDERDETERMINED because paternity lacks explicit textual resolution, which uses a single verse's non-statement as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
